title: Destination History Share for Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Instant Debit-Card Transfers
content:
**Risk schedule — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan instant transfers to an external debit card.**

The new-destination share multiplies the instant transfer amount by **60 percent** when no instant transfer to an external debit card was booked on the plan in the last six months before today, by **80 percent** when one or two were, and in full when three or more were.

Transfers booked today do not enter the count. A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

| Instant external debit card transfers booked in the last six months, today excluded | Share |
|---|---|
| none | 60 percent |
| 1 or 2 | 80 percent |
| 3 or more | in full |

*Hypothetical:* a worker whose only instant debit-card transfers are two from last month and one booked earlier today counts two, 80 percent; a worker who has only ever used next-business-day bank transfers counts none, 60 percent.
